mainStory.purpose: Explain why HUANDENG exists: a story-first, page-oriented slide editor for work that has to sound like a person.
mainStory.audience: Researchers and builders who make presentations and work with AI agents.
mainStory.takeaway: The AI look is an absence of focus. HUANDENG keeps the human story beside the page, gives every page a stable identity and its own history, and lets the talk and the evidence survive the edit.

story.purpose: Follow the observations that started the project: the room that could tell, the everything-deck, the turn to story-first, and the two walls of copies and screenshot review.
story.audience: Researchers and builders who make presentations and work with AI agents.
story.takeaway: The problem is upstream of layout; the unit of change and the unit of review both had to become the page.

story.purpose: Show the editor as the answer to those walls: one working document, Story beside the page, stable IDs, page history and diffs, a real materials library, shared presentations, and delivery.
story.audience: Researchers and builders who make presentations and work with AI agents.
story.takeaway: A page can keep its purpose, identity, evidence and history while the deck keeps changing.
